en: The County of Empuries, also known as the County of Ampurias, as a medieval county centred on the town of Empuries and enclosing the Catalan region of Peralada
Its correspondence to the historic comarca of Emporda
zh: 安普里亚斯伯国又称阿姆普里亚斯伯国，是围绕安普里亚斯城并包括佩拉拉达地区的中世纪伯国
地域相当于历史上的恩波尔达县

politics.zh: 安普里亚斯伯国又称阿姆普里亚斯伯国，是围绕安普里亚斯城并包括佩拉拉达地区的中世纪伯国，地域相当于历史上的恩波尔达县，位于加泰罗尼亚东北部沿海。它形成于10世纪加洛林边区，由世袭伯爵统治，在加泰罗尼亚诸伯国中地位重要，14世纪后因继承与王室干预逐步并入阿拉贡王室的领地。
politics.en: The County of Empuries, also known as the County of Ampurias, was a medieval county centred on the town of Empuries and enclosing the Catalan region of Peralada, corresponding to the historic comarca of Emporda on the north-eastern coast of Catalonia. It took shape in the tenth century within the Carolingian march and was ruled by hereditary counts, holding an important place among the Catalan counties until inheritance and royal intervention brought it gradually under the Crown of Aragon in the fourteenth century.

economy.zh: 伯国经济以地中海沿岸的农业、渔业与港口贸易为基础，安普里亚斯港参与西地中海商路，葡萄与橄榄种植以及盐业是重要收入来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, fishing and port trade along the Mediterranean, the harbour of Empuries taking part in western Mediterranean routes, and vines, olives and salt production being important sources of income.

culture.zh: 伯国属加泰罗尼亚语言与法律文化区，罗马式教堂与修道院留下建筑遗产，中世纪文献记录了伯爵家族与地方教会的关系。
culture.en: The county belonged to the Catalan world of language and law, its Romanesque churches and monasteries are architectural heritage, and medieval documents record the relations between the comital family and the local church.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪伯国形成、11至13世纪伯爵家族的统治、14世纪的继承争端，以及14世纪后并入阿拉贡王室领地。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the tenth century, the rule of its comital family in the eleventh to thirteenth centuries, the inheritance disputes of the fourteenth and its absorption into the Crown of Aragon afterwards.

value.zh: 位于加泰罗尼亚东北部沿海，相当于历史上的恩波尔达县。
value.en: It lay on the north-eastern Catalan coast, corresponding to the historic comarca of Emporda.

value.zh: 形成于10世纪加洛林边区。
value.en: It took shape in the tenth century within the Carolingian march.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该伯国的独立条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this county, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Republic of Florence, also known as the Florentine Republic, as a medieval and Renaissance state centred on the city of Florence
Its rule by elected councils and guilds, and later the rise of the Medici family to dominance
zh: 佛罗伦萨共和国又称佛罗伦萨共和国，是以佛罗伦萨城为中心的中世纪与文艺复兴国家
由选举产生的议会与行会治理，后来美第奇家族取得主导地位

politics.zh: 佛罗伦萨共和国是以佛罗伦萨城为中心的中世纪与文艺复兴国家，由选举产生的议会与行会治理。它在13至15世纪间是意大利半岛的重要力量，控制托斯卡纳大部，金融与外交影响遍及欧洲；15世纪美第奇家族通过银行与政治网络取得实际主导，1532年共和国体制被公国取代。
politics.en: The Republic of Florence, also known as the Florentine Republic, was a medieval and Renaissance state centred on the city of Florence, governed by elected councils and guilds. Through the thirteenth to fifteenth centuries it was an important power in the Italian peninsula, controlling much of Tuscany, and its financial and diplomatic influence reached across Europe; in the fifteenth century the Medici family gained effective dominance through its bank and political network, and in 1532 the republic gave way to a duchy.

economy.zh: 经济以银行业、毛纺织业与国际贸易为基础，佛罗伦萨的金币弗罗林是欧洲通用货币，美第奇银行在各国宫廷放贷，羊毛与丝绸工坊雇工众多。
economy.en: The economy rested on banking, wool manufacturing and international trade, the Florentine florin serving as a currency across Europe, the Medici bank lending to courts in many countries, and wool and silk workshops employing large numbers of workers.

culture.zh: 佛罗伦萨是文艺复兴的发源地，但丁、彼特拉克与薄伽丘奠定了意大利文学传统，乔托、布鲁内莱斯基与米开朗基罗等艺术家在此创作，人文主义学术与图书馆影响深远。
culture.en: Florence was the birthplace of the Renaissance: Dante, Petrarch and Boccaccio laid the foundations of Italian literature, artists such as Giotto, Brunelleschi and Michelangelo worked there, and its humanist scholarship and libraries had a lasting influence.

events.zh: 关键节点包括12世纪自治公社的形成、13世纪的行会政治与圭尔夫派与吉伯林派之争、1434年美第奇家族掌权，以及1532年改为公国。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the self-governing commune in the twelfth century, the guild politics and Guelph-Ghibelline conflicts of the thirteenth, the Medici assumption of power in 1434 and the change to a duchy in 1532.

value.zh: 佛罗伦萨金币弗罗林是欧洲通用货币。
value.en: The Florentine florin served as a currency across Europe.
In 1532 the republic gave way to a duchy.

entries.titleZh: 奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国

en: The Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, also called Cilician Armenia, Lesser Armenia or New Armenia, as an Armenian state formed during the High Middle Ages
Its formation by Armenian refugees fleeing the Seljuk invasion of Armenia
Its location outside historic Armenia, in the region of Cilicia
zh: 奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国又称小亚美尼亚或新亚美尼亚，是中世纪盛期形成的亚美尼亚国家
由逃避塞尔柱入侵的亚美尼亚难民建立
位于历史亚美尼亚之外的奇里乞亚地区

politics.zh: 奇里乞亚亚美尼亚王国又称小亚美尼亚或新亚美尼亚，是中世纪盛期形成的亚美尼亚国家，由逃避塞尔柱入侵的亚美尼亚难民在奇里乞亚建立。它由鲁本王朝与后来的吕西尼昂家族统治，1198年获得王号，与十字军国家、拜占庭及蒙古保持复杂关系，是东地中海的重要政治力量，1375年为马穆鲁克王朝所灭。
politics.en: The Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, also known as Cilician Armenia, Lesser Armenia or New Armenia, was an Armenian state formed during the High Middle Ages by Armenian refugees fleeing the Seljuk invasion of Armenia, and it lay outside historic Armenia in the region of Cilicia. Ruled by the Rubenid dynasty and later by the Lusignans, it obtained a royal crown in 1198 and maintained complex relations with the Crusader states, Byzantium and the Mongols as an important power in the eastern Mediterranean until the Mamluks destroyed it in 1375.

economy.zh: 经济以奇里乞亚沿海的港口贸易、农业与手工业为基础，阿亚斯等港口连接欧洲、黎凡特与中亚商路，关税与转口贸易是国家收入的重要来源。
economy.en: The economy rested on port trade along the Cilician coast, farming and crafts, with harbours such as Ayas linking Europe, the Levant and Central Asian routes, and customs and transit trade forming important sources of state revenue.

culture.zh: 王国是亚美尼亚文化与西欧接触的桥梁，亚美尼亚教会与拉丁教会并存，手抄本彩饰与建筑融合亚美尼亚与西欧风格，法律汇编与史学著作在此编纂。
culture.en: The kingdom was a bridge between Armenian culture and western Europe, the Armenian and Latin churches coexisting there, its illuminated manuscripts and architecture combining Armenian and western styles, and law codes and historical works being compiled at its court.

events.zh: 关键节点包括11世纪末难民定居奇里乞亚、1198年获得王号、13世纪与蒙古及十字军国家的联盟，以及1375年为马穆鲁克所灭。
events.en: Key moments are the settlement of refugees in Cilicia at the end of the eleventh century, the grant of a royal crown in 1198, the alliances with the Mongols and the Crusader states in the thirteenth and the Mamluk conquest of 1375.

value.en: It obtained a royal crown in 1198.

en: The Duchy of Burgundy as a medieval and early modern feudal polity in the north-western regions of historical Burgundy
Its membership of the Kingdom of France and its position bordering the Kingdom of Burgundy to the east and south
zh: 勃艮第公国是历史勃艮第西北部的中世纪与近代早期封建政体
属法兰西王国，东与南邻勃艮第王国

politics.zh: 勃艮第公国是历史勃艮第西北部的中世纪与近代早期封建政体，属法兰西王国，东与南邻勃艮第王国。它以第戎为中心，14至15世纪在瓦卢瓦家族的扩展下形成包括佛兰德、阿图瓦与尼德兰在内的勃艮第国家，与法国王室长期对抗；1477年公爵大胆查理战死后公国被法国兼并。
politics.en: The Duchy of Burgundy was a medieval and early modern feudal polity in the north-western regions of historical Burgundy, belonging to the Kingdom of France and bordering the Kingdom of Burgundy to the east and south. Centred on Dijon, it grew under the Valois dukes in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries into a Burgundian state that included Flanders, Artois and the Netherlands and long confronted the French crown; after Duke Charles the Bold was killed in 1477 the duchy was annexed by France.

economy.zh: 经济以葡萄种植、农业与勃艮第及尼德兰城市的纺织贸易为基础，第戎与布鲁日、根特构成跨区域的商业网络，公爵的收入来自领地税与城市特权。
economy.en: The economy rested on viticulture, farming and the textile trade of the Burgundian and Netherlandish towns, with Dijon, Bruges and Ghent forming a cross-regional commercial network, and the duke's income coming from domain taxes and urban privileges.

culture.zh: 勃艮第宫廷是15世纪欧洲宫廷文化的中心，绘画、音乐与挂毯艺术繁荣，尚波尔与第戎的修道院与宫殿留下建筑遗产，骑士文学与编年史在此兴盛。
culture.en: The Burgundian court was a centre of European court culture in the fifteenth century, painting, music and tapestry flourished, the monasteries and palaces of Champmol and Dijon left an architectural heritage, and chivalric literature and chronicles prospered there.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪公国形成、1363年瓦卢瓦家族入主、14至15世纪尼德兰领地的整合，以及1477年公爵战死后公国被法国兼并。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the duchy in the tenth century, the accession of the Valois in 1363, the integration of the Netherlandish lands in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries and the French annexation after the duke's death in 1477.

value.en: France annexed it after the duke's death in 1477.

en: The Kingdom of the Burgundians, or First Kingdom of Burgundy, as one of the barbarian kingdoms of the late Western Roman Empire in the fifth and sixth centuries
Its beginning in what is now western Switzerland and south-eastern France
Its rule by Burgundian kings who were successors of an earlier Rhine kingdom
zh: 勃艮第人王国又称第一勃艮第王国，是5至6世纪西罗马帝国晚期的蛮族王国之一
起于今瑞士西部与法国东南部
由继承莱茵地区早期王国的勃艮第国王统治

politics.zh: 勃艮第人王国又称第一勃艮第王国，是5至6世纪西罗马帝国晚期的蛮族王国之一，起于今瑞士西部与法国东南部，由继承莱茵地区早期王国的勃艮第国王统治。王国在贡多巴德等国王时期编纂法典，与法兰克人反复交战，534年被法兰克人征服并并入法兰克王国，其地后来成为勃艮第地区的核心。
politics.en: The Kingdom of the Burgundians, or First Kingdom of Burgundy, was one of the so-called barbarian kingdoms of the late Western Roman Empire in the fifth and sixth centuries. It began in what is now western Switzerland and south-eastern France and was ruled by Burgundian kings who were successors of an earlier kingdom on the Rhine. Its kings such as Gundobad issued law codes and it fought repeatedly with the Franks, until the Franks conquered it in 534 and incorporated it into their kingdom, its lands becoming the core of the later Burgundy region.

economy.zh: 经济以罗讷河谷的农业、葡萄种植与河流贸易为基础，罗马时期留下的城市与道路继续使用，王国从过境贸易与土地税收中取得收入。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, viticulture and river trade in the Rhone valley, the cities and roads left by Rome remained in use, and the kingdom drew income from transit trade and land taxation.

culture.zh: 勃艮第人接受罗马文化与基督教，拉丁语用于法律与文书，贡多巴德法典是日耳曼法与罗马法结合的实例，修道院在社会生活中作用显著。
culture.en: The Burgundians adopted Roman culture and Christianity, Latin served law and documents, the law code of Gundobad is an example of Germanic law combined with Roman practice, and monasteries played a prominent part in social life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括5世纪初莱茵地区的早期王国、443年前后罗马当局安置勃艮第人于萨伏依、5世纪末的扩张，以及534年被法兰克人征服。
events.en: Key moments are the early kingdom on the Rhine in the fifth century, the settlement of the Burgundians in Savoy by Roman authorities around 443, their expansion at the end of that century and the Frankish conquest of 534.

value.zh: 贡多巴德等国王时期编纂法典。
value.en: Its kings such as Gundobad issued law codes.

en: The County of Flanders as one of the most powerful political entities in the medieval Low Countries
Its location on the North Sea coast of modern-day Belgium and north-eastern France
Its membership of the Kingdom of France, unlike neighbouring Brabant and Hainaut
zh: 佛兰德伯国是中世纪低地国家中最强大的政治体之一
位于今比利时与法国东北部的北海沿岸
与布拉班特、埃诺不同，属法兰西王国

politics.zh: 佛兰德伯国是中世纪低地国家中最强大的政治实体之一，位于今比利时与法国东北部的北海沿岸，与布拉班特、埃诺不同，它属于法兰西王国。伯爵凭借城市财富在英法之间周旋，14世纪的城市起义与百年战争使其政局动荡，1384年并入勃艮第公爵领地，此后随勃艮第国家与哈布斯堡的继承而变化。
politics.en: The County of Flanders was one of the most powerful political entities in the medieval Low Countries, on the North Sea coast of what is now Belgium and north-eastern France, and unlike neighbouring Brabant and Hainaut it belonged to the Kingdom of France. Its counts used the wealth of its towns to manoeuvre between England and France, the urban revolts and the Hundred Years' War made its politics turbulent in the fourteenth century, and in 1384 it passed to the dukes of Burgundy, later following the fortunes of the Burgundian state and the Habsburg inheritance.

economy.zh: 经济以毛纺织业、呢绒贸易与港口航运为基础，布鲁日、根特与伊珀尔是欧洲最重要的工商业城市，英格兰羊毛是原料来源，布鲁日一度是北欧金融与贸易中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on wool textiles, the cloth trade and shipping, with Bruges, Ghent and Ypres among the most important commercial and industrial cities in Europe, English wool the source of raw material, and Bruges for a time the financial and trading centre of northern Europe.

culture.zh: 佛兰德是北方文艺复兴绘画的发源地，凡·艾克兄弟与梅姆林等画家在此工作，城市行会赞助教堂与市政建筑，挂毯与音乐传统同样闻名。
culture.en: Flanders was the birthplace of northern Renaissance painting, with the van Eyck brothers and Memling working there, its town guilds patronising churches and civic buildings, and its tapestry and music traditions equally famous.

events.zh: 关键节点包括9世纪伯国形成、12至13世纪城市与纺织业的繁荣、1302年金马刺战役、14世纪的城市起义，以及1384年并入勃艮第公爵领地。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the county in the ninth century, the prosperity of its towns and cloth industry in the twelfth and thirteenth, the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, the urban revolts of the fourteenth century and its passage to the dukes of Burgundy in 1384.

value.zh: 属法兰西王国，与布拉班特、埃诺不同。
value.en: Unlike Brabant and Hainaut it belonged to the Kingdom of France.

value.zh: 布鲁日、根特与伊珀尔是欧洲重要工商业城市。
value.en: Bruges, Ghent and Ypres were major European commercial cities.
